description: This file defines the VTEventTrigger class responsible for managing event triggers in the vtiger CRM system, including cache management, retrieval of active event handlers, and execution of event workflows.

classes.name: VTEventTrigger
classes.description: A class that manages event trigger execution, caching, and retrieval of active event handlers.

methods.name: initCache
methods.description: Initializes the internal cache of active event handlers, optionally for specific event names or forcibly.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if the cache for the given event name exists or if the cache has been initialized for all events.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the cache, either completely or for a specific event name.

methods.name: lookupCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached event handler info for a specific event name.

methods.name: getActiveEventInfos
methods.description: Fetches active event handler information from the database, optionally filtered by event names.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for VTEventTrigger, initializes with database connection and event name.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Executes handlers for a given event if their conditions are met, considering dependencies between handlers.
